cl: Competidores directos YA venden 'verificado/sin bots' como reclamo principal al cliente (PremiumChat 'no bots or fakes', CooMeet 'verified female users'); la USP resuena pero NO es unica -> diferenciador debe ser KYC real documento+liveness (Didit) vs 'video selfie badge' flojo
q: Premium Chat: multi-step verification ensures every person is genuine, no bots or fakes. CooMeet: verified female users. Verification badges via video selfie.
